context: A uni student gives his teen friend recommendations
purpose: Teach: 大豆/エビ/日本酒/書物/ドラム/ドコモ/馬場/ローズ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 先輩、最近ハマってるものとかあります？なんかおすすめ教えてください。
lines.en: Senpai, is there anything you're into lately? Recommend me something.
lines.style: Curious teen casually asking older friend for recommendations

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: おすすめか〜。最近ローズって新人バンドにハマってて、ドラムの音がマジでヤバいんだよ。
lines.en: Recommendations, huh. Lately I'm hooked on a new band called Rose, the drum sound is seriously insane.
lines.style: Uni student sharing genuine music passion with peer enthusiasm

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ローズですか、メモしときます！ドラム好きな人って渋いですね。
lines.en: Rose, huh, I'll write it down! People who love drums are pretty cool.
lines.style: Teen reacting with interest and lightly teasing senpai

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: あと食べ物なら、大学の近くの店の大豆ハンバーグがめっちゃ美味いよ。ヘルシーだし。
lines.en: Also for food, the soy hamburger at the place near my university is super tasty. And healthy too.
lines.style: Uni student casually recommending campus area food spot

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 大豆ハンバーグ！？意外と美味しそう。私エビとか好きなんですけど、そういう系はあります？
lines.en: Soy hamburger?! Sounds surprisingly tasty. I like shrimp and stuff, is there anything like that?
lines.style: Teen reacting with surprise then pivoting to own food preferences

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: エビなら高田馬場のエビ天そばが最高。駅出てすぐだから今度連れてくよ。
lines.en: For shrimp, the shrimp tempura soba at Takadanobaba is the best. It's right out of the station, I'll take you sometime.
lines.style: Uni student recommending specific local food spot with warmth

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 高田馬場！行きたいです。あと先輩、本もたくさん読みますよね？何かおすすめあります？
lines.en: Takadanobaba! I want to go. Also senpai, you read a lot of books too, right? Got any recommendations?
lines.style: Teen excited then shifting to ask about reading habits

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 難しい書物じゃなくていいから、ドコモのdマガジンとかで雑誌読むのも勉強になるよ。
lines.en: It doesn't have to be difficult books, even reading magazines on Docomo's d Magazine is good study.
lines.style: Older friend giving low-pressure practical reading advice

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: なるほど〜。じゃあ二十歳になったら日本酒もおすすめしてくれます？
lines.en: I see. Then when I turn twenty, will you recommend sake to me too?
lines.style: Teen joking ahead about adulthood with cheeky curious tone

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: まだ早いって！でも日本酒は地域ごとに全然違って面白いから、その時はちゃんと教えるよ。
lines.en: Way too early! But sake is really interesting because it differs by region, so I'll properly teach you then.
lines.style: Uni student playfully scolding then promising future guidance warmly
